ratings.note: f: only residents who pause over 5 minutes; i: expired screenshot shows bare 'no longer available' with slot blanked and no link, so recovery must be worked out; p: recurs on each lapse. s=3.
f: phones are the main device and 360 px or narrower is common; i: grid overflows by 16-32 px, sideways scroll or clipped column, an annoyance; p: overcome by scrolling once known. s=2.
f: every booking passes the Book button; i: 1.5 s with no visible change causes uncertainty and repeat taps (the cancellation consequence is rated in its own finding); p: recurs each booking. s=3.
f: van and trailer bookings without a valid permit; i: probe shows the error only after all details are filled, unlinked, with no permit field on the confirm page; p: each such attempt. s=3.
f: only cancelled-status visits; i: screenshot shows h1 'Booked' and gate instructions contradicting a red status line, risking a wasted trip; p: every time the page is reopened. s=3.
f: Today is preselected and same-day bookings are common; i: rejection only after three steps of input; p: every same-day booking. s=3.
f: keyboard and screen-reader users in the error state; i: must tab to the control themselves; p: each error. s=2.

f: first-time van and trailer residents; i: icon-only help may be missed; p: learned once. s=1; raised to 2 because the hidden content (permit rules, lead time) decides whether a van owner is turned away, a business exposure for older users.
f: Today is preselected; i: probe shows the past-slot error only after vehicle, waste and all details; p: every same-day booking. s=3.

f: every completed booking; i: no day, time or vehicle on the page shown at the gate with poor signal; p: recurs per visit. s=4; rated 3 because the time was chosen moments earlier and an SMS reminder arrives the evening before, so a wrong arrival is possible but not the usual outcome.
f: every booking passes step 2; i: must recall the slot; p: every booking. s=3; rated 2 because the confirm step shows day and slot with a Change link before anything is committed.
f: keyboard-only residents, named in context; i: probe shows a focused slot drawn the same as its neighbours among 29 boxes, risking the wrong time; p: cannot be learned away. s=3.
f: screen-reader users in the error state; i: error not announced on the control, so they must find it from the summary; p: each error. s=2.

f: low-vision and forced-colours users; i: screenshot shows the selected day only by a faint tint and thicker border, though the 'Saturday 17 October' caption below gives a text cue; p: every visit. s=2.
f: anyone whose plans change, a core task; i: no online path at all, only a weekday office-hours phone call, i.e. a support contact by definition; p: every change. s=4.
f: only taps within 0.9 s of a day change; i: silent no-op, a second tap works; p: transient. s=1.
f: double taps are likely given no pending feedback; i: booking silently stored as cancelled, so the resident is turned away at the gate (loss); p: persists on the done page. s=4.
f: every day change; i: probe shows about one second of empty area under the old date; p: recurs. s=3; rated 2 because it resolves by itself within a second and the most likely cost is a repeat tap.
f: screenshot shows ten few-left slots above 'Morning' on most days; i: afternoon slots read as morning and focus jumps, though every tile states its time; p: every visit. s=3.
f: every car booking, the common case; i: an unmarked permit field invites hesitation from residents who do not know only vans need permits; p: occasional users meet it afresh. s=3.
f: every Change slot in a core task; i: screenshots show reset to Today, with re-navigation and a risk of picking the wrong day; p: each change. s=3.
f: only mistyped Another-day entries; i: the old day's grid stays live, so a wrong-day slot can be booked; p: each invalid entry. s=2.
f: matters to residents interrupted mid-flow; i: slot lost and found out only at the last step; p: occasional users will not remember the limit. s=3.
f: low-vision residents on most days; i: 'Few left' at about 3:1 is hard to read but secondary to the time; p: every visit. s=2.
f: every Change slot; i: probe produced a booking for Monday 12 instead of 17 October, visible only on the confirm summary; p: every change. s=3.
f: screen-reader users; i: trivial because the h1 names the step; p: every step. s=1.
f: lapsed holds; i: screenshot shows unlinked message, slot blanked, and Book this slot inviting a futile retry; p: each lapse. s=3.
f: anyone who pauses mid-flow; i: losing a scarce slot without warning; p: every booking. s=3.
f: van owners without a permit booking near-term; i: wasted day and slot choice, restart; p: once per resident. s=2.
f: every change-slot or back navigation; i: day reset to Today with the risk of a wrong-day slot; p: every return. s=3.
f: every load and day change; i: 0.9 s blank plus layout shift; p: recurs. s=3; rated 2 because it resolves within a second without action.
f: every booking; i: probe screenshot unchanged for about 1.5 s, inviting repeat taps; p: every submission. s=3.
f: most days, every width; i: screenshot shows afternoon slots above 'Morning', mismatching the spoken grouping; p: every visit. s=3.
f: any resident whose plans change (core task); i: impossible online, only a weekday phone call (support contact); p: every booking. s=4.
f: keyboard and switch users; i: focus invisible on the core choice, including after the error moves focus there; p: not learnable. s=3.
f: van and trailer residents without a permit; i: must find the application elsewhere, a real difficulty for residents who do not know where permits come from; p: once per resident. s=2.
f: residents pausing over 5 minutes; i: slot lost without warning or reason; p: occasional users will not remember. s=3.
f: cancelled bookings only; i: screenshot shows h1 'Booked' and 'Show this at the gate' around the red cancelled line, risking a wasted trip; p: each view. s=3.
